content:
Earlier this year, Twelve South launched its brand-new Valet accessory, which they described as a "wireless charging stand and personal tray for everyday items".

Now, Twelve South has expanded the Valet lineup, adding a smaller option that supports MagSafe and Qi2.2 wireless charging at up to 25W.

The first-generation Valet announced earlier this year measures 7.5 inches, designed to hold a phone, keys, wallet, glasses and other everyday carry items. However, the new Valet is significantly smaller at just 4.25 inches.

Here is Twelve South's description of Valet's premium design:

Valet is, first and foremost, a beautiful piece of home decor, and second, a precision wireless charger. It combines warm materials with modern craftsmanship to create a calmer, more thoughtful design form that fits perfectly on an entryway console, kitchen counter or bedside table. The soft square charging pad echoes the architectural lines of the leather tray, while the weighted zinc-alloy base keeps everything steady and organized.

In terms of features, the smaller Valet has plenty of charging capability to power up your iPhone. It also has a built-in additional USB-C port for charging other accessories:

  • Qi2.2 wireless charging up to 25W
  • Premium Nappa leather tray
  • Four configurable placement modes
  • Interchangeable, removable leather bezel
  • Weighted zinc-alloy base with built-in cable management
  • Additional USB-C port with up to 10W wired charging
  • Includes a 45W power adapter and 1.5-meter USB-C cable

Twelve South's 4.25-inch Valet is now available for pre-order at $129.99 in three color options. It's not cheap, but it's a great-looking spot to charge your phone while resting your glasses, wallet or keys.
